synopsis: The Sun will eventually swell into a red giant, consuming inner planets, before shrinking into a dense white dwarf.
narration: In five billion years, our Sun will transform, expanding into a red giant that engulfs its inner worlds. Eventually, it will shed its outer layers, leaving behind a beautiful, fading white dwarf, marking the silent end of our stellar companion.

shots.prompt: A serene view of the current Sun, bright and life-giving, subtly pulsating with hidden energy, camera slowly panning across its surface.
The Sun rapidly swelling into a terrifying red giant, its bloated, crimson-orange surface filling the frame, consuming Mercury and Venus as Earth appears as a distant, doomed ember.
A small, extremely dense white dwarf, a brilliant, hot pearl, slowly cooling in the vast darkness of space, surrounded by a faint, expanding planetary nebula.

music: A grand, evolving cosmic symphony with a sense of inevitable change, starting with a steady pulse, building to a dramatic swell as the red giant forms, then subtly fading with an unresolved, looping close.
